name: Andrea Lieberstein
reason: Health rule: her own site (mindfuleatingtraining.com, Mindful Eating Training Institute) is built around mindful-eating and nutrition programmes that she says address disordered eating, overeating, body image and weight concerns, and her main offers are professional MB-EAT certification and Well Nourished coaching led by her as a registered dietitian. The work is mainly condition-led nutrition, so little would pass the strict health-claim rule. (Her site is also Wix-hosted, whose image host refuses our robots.txt request.)
